response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS avg_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rk FROM c) SELECT circuitId, avg_round, race_count, share FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC
